sections.advice: Scenic stretch near Kentfield → Photo stop near Lucas Valley-Marinwood is the reward section in San Francisco Bay Area. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.to: Near San Ramon, on the way back
sections.advice: Photo stop near Lucas Valley-Marinwood → Near San Ramon, on the way back is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

sections.from: Near San Ramon, on the way back

sections.advice: Food stop near Fairview → Back to Sonoma Coast is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.

scenicChapters.title: Moselle Wine Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 37 km this is Moselle Wine Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-fort-site-and-civil-settlement-of.story: A 278 km round trip from Friedberg - roughly 4 h 48 in the saddle. It goes by way of Watchtowers WP 3/45 to 3/52 including the, Watchtower WP 3/4*, Limessection between watchtowers WP 2/13 a and Watchtowers WP 1/41 to 1/50 including the. The line favours views over speed.
